title: Baddies Mean Business
author: Rylie Jennings
description: Creating positive media for free-thinkers. Baddies Mean Business shares the real stories of ambitious women pursuing their greatest passions and willing to share the motivations behind them. Welcome to the "waterfall of knowledge"; sharing what women know through experience and are willing to share their advice to YOU. Rylie Jennings is a GenZ woman with an endless curiosity about the human experience, innovation, and creativity. Through her work in venture capital, start-ups and non-profits, she's on the pursuit to define what makes life meaningful.
